statement: You are given a sorted array nums in which every value appears exactly twice, except for one value that appears only once.
Return the value that appears once.

The solution must run in O(log n) time and O(1) extra space. Before the single element, each pair starts at an even index; after it, each pair starts at an odd index. Checking which pattern holds at the midpoint tells you which side the single element is on.

examples.explanation: Every value except 2 appears as a pair. 2, at index 2, matches neither of its neighbours.
1, 2, 3 and 5 each appear twice. 4 appears only once, at index 6.
